'''Chappral''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the Imperial capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where he trained fellow Imperials in the art of manufacturing [[Armor/Legends|armor]].
